Test version {version} of the Jamii Pulse app for Community Health Promoters, for a university project. It talks to the test server at {server}; data is stored in {location}.

**You can only log in once the project team has registered your phone number and email address.** Your login code arrives by email, so check your spam folder too.

### Install (Android)

1. On your phone, open this page and tap **jamii-pulse-{version}.apk** below to download it.
2. Open the downloaded file. If your phone asks, allow your browser to install unknown apps (Settings → Install unknown apps).
3. If Google Play Protect warns about an unknown app, tap **More details → Install anyway**. The app is not on the Play Store because it is a test version.
4. Open Jamii Pulse, read the notice, and log in with your phone number.

A newer version installs over this one; your sent reports stay on the server.

### Kusakinisha (Android)

**Unaweza kuingia tu baada ya timu ya mradi kusajili namba yako ya simu na anwani yako ya barua pepe.** Nambari ya kuingia itafika kwa barua pepe; angalia pia folda ya barua taka (spam).

1. Kwenye simu yako, fungua ukurasa huu na ubonyeze **jamii-pulse-{version}.apk** hapa chini ili kuipakua.
2. Fungua faili uliyopakua. Simu ikiuliza, ruhusu kivinjari chako kusakinisha programu zisizojulikana (Mipangilio → Sakinisha programu zisizojulikana).
3. Google Play Protect ikionya kuhusu programu isiyojulikana, bonyeza **Maelezo zaidi → Sakinisha hata hivyo**. Programu haipo Play Store kwa sababu ni toleo la majaribio.
4. Fungua Jamii Pulse, soma ilani, kisha ingia kwa namba yako ya simu.

The `.sha256` file holds the APK's checksum, for anyone who wants to check the download.
